_help: TEMPLATE – copy this folder, rename it (the folder name becomes the URL /portfolio/<name>/), add your images and fill in the fields. Folders starting with _ are ignored. PORTFOLIO PROJECT (shown on /portfolio/). See /docs/CONTENT-GUIDE.md -> Portfolio. 'projectStatus' is the label on the card (e.g. Konzeptarbeit, Eigenprojekt, Kundenprojekt). 'disclaimer' is shown on the detail page. 'layout' sets the card size: feature | side | tall | wide | closing. The first entry in 'images' is the main motif; the others appear under 'Weitere Motive'. Images are shown uncropped.
